description: The plot titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” illustrates how three evaluation metrics vary across different model variants in an ablation setting. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” on a categorical (non-numeric) scale with five categories: “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 56 to 66, with major ticks at 58, 60, 62, 64, and 66. Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: a purple line (Precision) with values 65.45 at “Full model (Ours),” 61.06 at “w/o Prompt,” 62.22 at “w/o Augmentation,” 64.06 at “w/o Attention,” and 65.44 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation,” decreasing from the first to second category and then rising through the remaining categories; a blue line (Recall) with values 65.78, 59.64, 63.75, 59.17, and 56.82 respectively, dropping from the first to second category, rising to the third, and then declining through the fourth and fifth; and a tan/brown line (F1-score) with values 65.56, 60.16, 62.63, 59.67, and 57.74 respectively, decreasing from the first to second category, increasing to the third, and then decreasing across the fourth and fifth categories.
